name: Cute Felt Nurse Badge Reels (5 Pieces)
seoTitle: Cute Felt Nurse Badge Reels, 5 Pack
metaDescription: A set of five cute felt retractable badge reels for nurses who like to switch up their look. Easy to share, too, which makes it a great unit gift.
summary: Five cute felt badge reels in one set, so a nurse can rotate styles or share with coworkers. A budget friendly gift with lots of everyday use.
bestFor: Nurses who swap badge reels often
whyItWorks: Badge reels are a small world of their own in nursing. Some nurses change theirs with the seasons, others have a favorite for each holiday, and pediatric units practically run on cheerful accessories that help kids relax. A pack of five felt reels gives plenty of options and makes it easy to keep one clipped to every set of scrubs instead of moving one around each morning.

The multipack also opens up gift ideas. Split the set among a few coworkers on Nurses Week, tuck one into each card for a nursing school cohort, or give the whole bundle to a nurse who goes through badge reels quickly. Retractable reels get a workout over a long shift, pulled out to badge into med rooms and scan patients, so having spares on hand is genuinely practical. The title also mentions teachers, so they suit school nurses too. Check the listing photos to see the designs and make sure they match the recipient's style.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos for the specific designs included in the set.
Felt designs suit pediatric and school settings especially well.
Budget friendly, and the five pieces stretch across several small gifts.

faq.q: Can this set be split between coworkers?
faq.a: Yes, a multipack is an easy way to give a small gift to several people on your unit. Each reel works on its own.

faq.q: Are felt badge reels practical for hospital work?
faq.a: They hold a badge like any retractable reel. Felt can pick up grime over time, so having several to rotate helps.
